notes.title: PHOGS! December 2020 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]PHOGS! December 2020 Patch Notes[/h2]

Our first patch has gone live on Steam. Read our full patch notes below!

[b]Improvements[/b]
- Added support for Steam Input and Controller Configurations. There are official controller configurations available for Xbox One, DualShock 4, and Switch Pro controllers - or you can make your own!
- Added an in-game frame limiter (options: Unlimited, 30, 60, 120)
- Changed the way re-entering the final Temple sequence from the Home Hub works
- If you are in Temple World 1, you will restart Temple World 1 from the beginning.
- If you were in Temple World 2, you will be presented with the "You have progress in this level..." dialog. Accepting this dialog will then load the player into Temple World 2, declining it will start Temple World 1 from the beginning.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- Fixed an issue in Play World 4 where grabbing the crane minigame after using the dodgem would cause the PHOGS! to teleport back to the dodgem with hilarious results
- Fixed an online synchronisation issue with the spinning wheel in Sleep World 4
- Fixed a rare issue that could cause network instability upon unexpected network loss
- Fixed an issue where tennis balls could become stuck during the tennis match with Fredrick von Fun in the final Play World level
- Fixed an issue in Sleep World 4 where the heist achievement would not unlock if the Alarmo was used, even if the Phogs were never detected by the Watchers
- Fixed an issue where some Spring Cushions in Sleep World Hub would not bounce the PHOGS!
- Fixed an issue where a bone could end up becoming non-collectable by getting a glorb stuck in Sleep World 3
- Fixed a potential issue with some Watchers getting stuck in Temple World 2
- Fixed a potential issue where the PHOGS! would go into an 'endless fall' after jumping off a particular section

notes.title: PHOGS! Corsair iCue Integration
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce that you can play PHOGS! with official iCUE lighting integration. 

When you play PHOGS! on Corsair peripherals and components on December 3rd, you will get the most immersive gaming experience on PC.

The lightning of your Corsair peripherals & components will reflect what’s happening in the game. So, for example, the RGB lighting flashes blue when you spray water and it turns red when you breathe fire.

As long as you have CORSAIR iCUE-compatible devices, they will dynamically react to whatever is happening on-screen when you play PHOGS! See for yourself.

[previewyoutube=aS2PcG98HCw;full][/previewyoutube]

To learn more about how it works, click [url=https://playphogs.com/corsair-icue]here[/url]

We look forward to playing together with you on December 3rd!

notes.content:

We’re thrilled to announce that PHOGS! will be back at PAX East this year. You’ll have the chance to get a taste of all worlds in PHOGS! as we’re bringing a brand-new demo including Sleep, Food and Play World.

[h2]Fetch a PHOGS! pin![/h2]

As always, there will be lots of competitions for you to enter. Be sure to take lots of photos in the Phogbed for a chance to win one of our popular PHOGS! tees.

There is one more goodie to keep an eye on – sign up to our newsletter, show us your confirmation email and get a free PHOGS! pin. Please note that we have only limited availability on the pins.

[url=https://mailchi.mp/coatsink/phogs-pin]Get a pin!
[/url]

[h2]Find us at booth #16075!
[/h2]

You can find PHOGS! near the escalators by the main entrance. If you visited us before, you’ll find us very close to where our booth was last year. Take a look at the map below to find our booth #16075!

Now it’s time for our PHOGS! to start packing for their next adventure. We can’t wait to see you all in Boston at PAX East!
